title: Applied ML — Weekly Research Notes (2026-04-07)
content:
Week of 2026-04-07 — Applied ML weekly research notes (quantization, evals, model onboarding)

Summary:
- Focus this week: closing the q4 quantization gap for Llama-2-70B-family variants, expanding eval coverage for long-form coherence, and stabilizing onboarding pipeline for community models.
- High-level progress: causal transformer 4-bit kernels now handle KV-cache flush edge case (PR linked). Eval suite runs show ~4-6% generation-quality delta for q4_0 on open benchmarks; further tuning to reduce regression is in progress.

Standup highlights (daily):
- 2026-04-07 (Tue)
  - Ava: landed prototype patch for KV-cache alignment when switching quantized kernels; reduced memory spike in smoke tests. Next: run 1000-sample stability run on 70B-long sequence workload.
  - Diego: evaluated q4_0 vs q8_0 on instruction-tuning dataset (1.2k prompts). q4_0 latency improved 1.9x, perplexity delta +0.045 (acceptable for retrieval-backed tasks).
  - Priya: expanded eval harness with longform-coherence tests; added n-gram overlap, repetition penalty metrics, and a simple segmentation-based coherence scorer.
  - Liam: CI flakes on model-onboarding smoke tests — investigation shows a race in artifact unpacker on NFS mounts. Repro steps added to GH issue.

- 2026-04-08 (Wed)
  - Ava: ran 1000-sample stability run for 70B q4_0 with seq_len=4096. Observed 0.6% tokenization mismatch failures (root cause: tokenizer version mismatch in bundled artifacts). Filed JIRA-ML-490 to pin tokenizer version in onboarding pipeline.
  - Sofia: surveyed third-party community models (Mistral-family forks) for onboarding; compiled compatibility matrix (weights format, layer-norm naming, kv-cache shape).
  - Jamal: started A/B evaluation infrastructure for regression alerts; hooking into Console alerts to create automatic rollback signals for production-serving models.

Research / Experiments:
- Quantization experiments (Diego + Ava)
  - Models: Llama-2-70B (hf: llm-70b-v2), Llama-2-13B
  - Modes tested: fp16 baseline, q8_0, q4_0, q4_1 (experiment)
  - Workloads: 1) instruction-following (1.2k prompts), 2) long-form generation (250 prompts, seq_len=4096)
  - Results (summary):
    - Throughput: q4_0 ~1.9x vs fp16 (burst GPU util scenario), q8_0 ~1.3x
    - Latency p95: q4_0 improved by ~38% on average across seq_len 512-2048; at 4096 improvement ~28% due to memory pressure and additional kernel rounds
    - Quality (instruction set): q4_0 mean ROUGE-L delta -0.9 pts vs fp16; for some conversational prompts degenerated references increased by ~3%
    - Quality (longform-coherence): q4_0 shows increased repetition in the 3-grams after 1500 tokens; repetition penalty tuning and adaptive temperature scheduled needed
  - Action: run quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT) pilot on subset (50k steps) for 13B and 70B to test recovery of coherence. Ticket: JIRA-ML-495.

- Eval suite updates (Priya + Sofia)
  - Added longform-coherence metric (segmentation + coherence score), safety-checker pass rate, and back-compat tests vs previous release
  - Baseline eval runs executed nightly; artifacts stored under gs://redwood-evals/2026-04-07/{model}/{run_id} (internal-only)
  - Noted an increase in safety false positives for one community model; follow-up with safety team to confirm policy thresholds
  - Action items: add human-annotation batch for 200 longform cases next week; coordinate with Solutions Eng for labeling budget

- Model onboarding (Liam + Sofia)
  - Onboarding checklist updated: weight-format checks, tokenizer pin, config migration (layer_norm naming), kv-cache layout validation
  - Failing CI reproducible step: unpacker race on NFS when two jobs try to unpack same archive; mitigation: use lockfile per-artifact (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/867)
  - Community model onboarding: created compatibility matrix for Mistral forks and Llama-2 variants; flagged 3 models as high priority for Dedicated customers
  - Action: add artifact version locking in onboarding pipeline (JIRA-ML-487).

Meetings / Decisions:
- 2026-04-07: Quantization sync (30m)
  - Decision: prioritize q4_0 kernel stability before wide rollout; defer q4_1 experiments to next sprint unless QAT shows rapid improvements
  - Owner: Diego to finish kernel hotfix; Ava to run extended stability run on dedicated pool (2x longer)
  - Follow-up: engineering PM to schedule dedicated canary run on Dedicated clusters after stability sign-off

- 2026-04-08: Eval metrics review (45m)
  - Decision: adopt longform-coherence metric into nightly eval; add human review threshold at delta > 2.0 pts to trigger regression alert
  - Owner: Priya to add annotation queue and dashboard; Jamal to wire dashboard to Console alerting

Blockers / Risks:
- Tokenizer version mismatch in onboarding artifacts causing tokenization/align losses (blocking stable q4_0 runs on 70B long sequences). Mitigation: pin tokenizer and re-run onboarding images (JIRA-ML-490).
- CI flakes on artifact unpacking (NFS lock race). Short-term mitigation: retry with randomized backoff; mid-term: enforce per-artifact lockfile and move to object-store-backed caching.
- Quality regression for q4_0 on longform tasks (repetition). Risk of user-visible regressions if rolled out too quickly. Mitigation: QAT pilot + repetition penalty tuning + canary routing to lower tier customers first.

Action items (owner — due):
- Diego: complete kernel hotfix and land tests (due 2026-04-12) — JIRA-ML-488
- Ava: run 5k-sample stability run on dedicated staging (due 2026-04-14) — include seq_len=4096 and 8192 samples
- Priya: deploy longform-coherence dashboard and connect annotation queue (due 2026-04-15) — JIRA-ML-492
- Liam: implement per-artifact lockfile in unpacker (PR & tests) (due 2026-04-13) — github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/874
- Sofia: finalize community model compatibility matrix and propose 3 models for initial onboarding (due 2026-04-16)
- Jamal: wire regression alert to Console and create automatic fallback policy skeleton (due 2026-04-20)

Notes / Misc:
- Preliminary QAT schedule: 50k steps on 13B (2 GPUs) estimated ~48 hours; 50k steps on 70B requires multi-node setup — need infra estimate from Platform Eng.
- Cost estimate: running 5k stability samples on 70B (seq_len=4096) ~ 1.2 GPU-days of p99 infra (approx). Requesting capacity reservation for 2026-04-13 to 2026-04-14.
- Link to internal eval artifacts and logs: gs://redwood-evals/2026-04-07/ (internal ACL)

Open questions:
- If QAT recovers coherence for q4_0 but increases latency, do we prefer QAT+q4_0 or q8_0 baseline for Dedicated customers? (need product input on cost/latency tradeoffs)
- Should we backport tokenizer pin to older onboarding images that are still used by customers? Scope and risk?

Next meetings:
- Quantization deep-dive: 2026-04-12 10:00 PT (runbook: review QAT pilot results)
- Onboarding triage: 2026-04-14 09:30 PT (CI flakes + artifact locking)

End of notes.
